title: Rate-adjusted cardiac variability heterogeneity: an exploratory cross-database incremental test
abstract: Rate-adjusted between-window logRMSSD dispersion changed external CHF-label Brier loss by -0.00112 (joint source/target bootstrap 95% [-0.00853, 0.00283]) beyond conventional HRV and unadjusted dispersion. Incremental benefit was not established in this exploratory database comparison.
